cli.syntax: lox config load-manager set-power FILE SELECTOR IO_INDEX POWER_KW [--room ROOM] [--save-as PATH]
cli.units: Explicit kW, no reinterpretation; 0.001 kW = 1 W.
cli.accepted_subset: Nonnegative finite digit-before-dot decimal with <=3 fractional digits and decimal identity after f64/three-decimal conversion. No signs, exponents, whitespace, grouping or units in requests.
cli.rounding: Reject precision loss, excess decimals and exact half-milli binary ties (odd sixteenths) rather than silently round or assume native CRT tie-breaking. Rust formatting is a rejection guard, NOT native saved-byte parity evidence.
cli.storage_guard: Target must have explicit finite nonnegative pwr decimal parseable as f64. Signed plain decimals and decimal mantissas with zero exponents are supported; nonzero or non-decimal exponent forms, missing, empty or malformed storage are rejected, not defaulted. The permissive native reader is not a CLI domain specification. Other rows/settings are preserved, not repaired or filled.
cli.noop: Numeric equality is CLI preservation policy, not a recovered native skip-save callback. Preserve raw exponent/trailing-zero spellings. In-place no-op writes nothing; save-as retains Document stamp via ordinary writer.
cli.mutation: Only selected Load/@pwr; zero is explicit. Reuse fixed12/range0..11/unique resolved ioIdx/selection guards including omitted-zero identity. Preserve order and every unrelated attribute/child/wire/ID/flag/BOM/EOL.
cli.output: Existing inspection plus changed boolean; standard save-as/room/json/csv/quiet/no-header behavior.
